answer: An agent marketplace requires every seller, whether drafting a sonnet or monitoring willow growth, to lock 100 copper tokens for 30 days before taking jobs. Each bond supports only one active job, and a signed acceptance followed by failure to deliver by the deadline forfeits it. Creating fresh identities cannot reuse locked bonds: an attacker running 1,000 simultaneous scams must tie up 100,000 tokens and loses that stake on missed deliveries.
